import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io
import matplotlib.dates as mdates

# Prepare the data
data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22
2024-01-01,06:00,Latte,Large,6.37,2,Credit Card,45-54,1,12.74
2024-01-01,08:00,Americano,Medium,7.07,3,Cash,45-54,1,21.21
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# --- Data Preparation ---
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
df['customer_age_group'] = pd.Categorical(df['customer_age_group'], categories=age_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization ---
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 14), gridspec_kw={'hspace': 0.35, 'wspace': 0.25})
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard - January 1, 2024', fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

# --- Plot 1: Total Sales by Product ---
sales_by_product = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True).reset_index()
sns.barplot(ax=axes[0, 0], x='total', y='product', data=sales_by_product, palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('')
for i, total in enumerate(sales_by_product['total']):
    axes[0, 0].text(total + 0.2, i, f'${total:.2f}', va='center', ha='left', fontsize=11, color='black')
axes[0, 0].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axes[0, 0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Plot 2: Sales Trend Over Time ---
sales_by_time = df.sort_values('datetime')
sns.lineplot(ax=axes[0, 1], x='datetime', y='total', data=sales_by_time, marker='o', markersize=10, color='royalblue', lw=2.5, label='Transaction Value')
sns.scatterplot(ax=axes[0, 1], x='datetime', y='total', data=sales_by_time, hue='product', s=200, zorder=5, palette='viridis')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Transactions Over Time', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Time of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Total ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%H:%M'))
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Product')
axes[0, 1].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axes[0, 1].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Plot 3: Sales by Customer Age Group ---
sales_by_age = df.groupby('customer_age_group', observed=True)['total'].sum().reset_index()
sns.barplot(ax=axes[1, 0], x='customer_age_group', y='total', data=sales_by_age, palette='plasma')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for p in axes[1, 0].patches:
    axes[1, 0].annotate(f'${p.get_height():.2f}', (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                       ha='center', va='center', xytext=(0, 9), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axes[1, 0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Plot 4: Payment Method Distribution ---
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(payment_counts))
axes[1, 1].pie(payment_counts, labels=None, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
               wedgeprops=dict(width=0.4, edgecolor='w'), pctdistance=0.8, textprops={'fontsize': 12, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
axes[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(payment_counts.index, title="Method", loc="center")
axes[1, 1].axis('equal')

# --- Final Adjustments ---
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
